intent: Recognise original portrait versus landscape without assigning fictional appearance to source caretaker; quick sketch before selecting colours; broken pencil-case zip exact evidence with pencil case variant; contrasting colour in new blue-ground example without unique-source-white/red claim; darker green exact evidence without recipe; cloud changes shape while moving; leaf pattern not leaf material; fewer wood pieces not less mass.
